command.label: f75-control command
command.description: Binary name on PATH or an absolute path to the F75 Control Center build.

refresh_seconds.label: Refresh interval
refresh_seconds.description: How often the widget asks f75-control for a new status snapshot.

display.label: Bar text
display.description: How much information the widget shows next to its icon.

show_profile.label: Show active profile
show_profile.description: Include the active profile name in the bar text and tooltip.

show_effect.label: Show lighting effect
show_effect.description: Include the current lighting effect in the bar text.

show_connection.label: Show connection type
show_connection.description: Add USB or 2.4 GHz to the bar text.

colorize.label: Color by state
colorize.description: Green when writes are available, amber for a read-only receiver, red for missing access.

hide_when_disconnected.label: Hide when disconnected
hide_when_disconnected.description: Remove the widget from the bar while no AULA F75 is detected.

open_app_on_click.label: Open app on click
open_app_on_click.description: Launch F75 Control Center when the widget is clicked; otherwise the click refreshes the snapshot.

widget.binary_missing: f75-control was not found ({command}). Build the app or set the full path in the widget settings.
widget.write_limited: Read-only: the 2.4 GHz receiver drops settings writes; use the USB cable

panel.connect_hint: Connect the keyboard with the USB cable or the 2.4 GHz receiver.
